editorNote:
St Andrews Beach Brewery lists Lawrence Mooney for a comedy night at its Fingal venue on Sunday 20 December. The brewery says a second act is still to be announced. This is a stand-up performance at the brewery, not a general live-music session or a recurring weekly event. The microphone artwork on this page is a house illustration and does not depict the performers or the event.

The organiser's Eventbrite listing gives the full 2026 date and the address, 160 Sandy Road, Fingal. Doors are listed for 5pm and live comedy for 6:30pm to 9pm. The listing says the event is for ages 18 and over and has paid admission. It also mentions free parking. Allow time to arrive between doors and the start of the performance if you want to see the full set.

Check Eventbrite for the final lineup, current ticket terms and availability before making plans. The site has not independently confirmed remaining places or an event-specific access arrangement. If you need step-free access or another accommodation, contact the brewery before booking. The organiser's page and the event-specific ticket page were both checked on 19 November 2026.
